recent: IGBCR 于 2026 年 11 月 23 日出现大股东股权变动，公司于 10 月底公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，营收 7337 万令吉，并宣布每单位派息 1.37 仙。此外，管理人费用部分以新单位支付，涉及发行 428.6 万个新单位。

公司宣布 2026 年第三季度每单位派息 1.37 仙。
管理人费用部分以新单位支付，发行 428.6 万个新单位。
risks: 多名大股东及董事在 11 月申报股权变动，需留意后续持股变化。
2026 年第三季度净利环比下降 16.2%，净利率从 49.1% 降至 40.0%。
earnings: 2026 年第三季度营收为 7337 万令吉，环比增长 3.0%，同比增长 13.6%；净利为 2934.5 万令吉，环比下降 16.2%，同比下降 1.0%；净利率为 40.0%，低于上一季度的 49.1%。

recent_en: IGBCR saw a change in substantial shareholder interests on 23 November 2026, with IGB Corporation Berhad holding a direct 5.2% stake. The company announced its 3Q 2026 results at end-October, with revenue of RM73.37 million and a distribution of 1.37 sen per unit. In addition, part of the manager's fee was paid in new units, involving the issuance of 4.286 million new units.
notable_en: IGB Corporation Berhad became a direct substantial shareholder with a 5.2% stake.
The company declared a 3Q 2026 distribution of 1.37 sen per unit.
Part of the manager's fee was paid in new units, with 4.286 million new units issued.
risks_en: Several substantial shareholders and directors reported changes in their interests in November; further changes in holdings should be monitored.
3Q 2026 net income fell 16.2% quarter-on-quarter, with net margin declining from 49.1% to 40.0%.
earnings_en: 3Q 2026 revenue was RM73.37 million, up 3.0% quarter-on-quarter and 13.6% year-on-year; net income was RM29.345 million, down 16.2% quarter-on-quarter and 1.0% year-on-year; net margin was 40.0%, lower than 49.1% in the previous quarter.
